notes: StarknetToken (src/StarknetToken.sol) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 built on OpenZeppelin v5.1.0 ERC20 with no extensions. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply, 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units), once to msg.sender, which is the launch factory. There is no owner, admin role, mint, burn, pause, blocklist, fee or burn on transfer, and no external call in the constructor, so totalSupply() is constant for the life of the contract and every launch flow (the transfer to the MerkleDistributor, the pool seed through the PoolManager, claims and swaps) moves exactly what it says. No application contracts are deployed with this launch: the accepted tree contains only the token, a local deploy script and tests. The pool pairs with IMD at 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply, and pool.initialPrice is provenance only.
